decision: O protótipo não foi promovido. Fuji melhora modestamente, mas Skorost-1 cai44,08→33,75 FPS na série principal; Grand Prix, Thunderhead e Aurora também têm médias adversas. A dispersão e a carga não isolada limitam a atribuição causal, mas não justificam descartar essas perdas. Os testes de correção e a redução de trabalho não bastam para recomendar a mudança. Fontes e executável de trabalho voltaram byte por byte à v13; o protótipo está preservado em branch local separada. A investigação nativa adicional depende de recuperar a imagem legítima do jogo, ausente após a limpeza de Downloads relatada pelo usuário.

environment.unrelated_apps: host load not isolated; no other applications closed by agent

protocol.percentiles: mean of per-window percentiles, not pooled

earlier_topology_stable_only_prototype.reason_replaced: Only about0.5% of complete builds avoided in Fuji; replaced before controlled FPS comparison.

blocked_followup.missing_input: legitimate local disc image used by native runner
blocked_followup.user_report: Downloads cleanup; file may have been moved or deleted
blocked_followup.local_search: No ISO found in searched user folders or matching Recycle Bin entries; G drive unavailable. Not proof of absence on every device.
blocked_followup.planned_protocol: One new warm-up per binary then three BA/AB/BA pairs; declared after primary Skorost pair2, before pair3 finished; none completed.
remaining: Exact-final native Q checks in adverse scenes
Candidate thread profile and CPU counters

metric_definitions.simulation_fps: EE VBlank progress/wall after60 initial samples, not proof of original PS2 cadence
metric_definitions.stutter_over_33ms: pre-present callback intervals >33.3333ms, not simulation intervals/scanout
metric_definitions.zero_audio_queue_samples: SDL empty-queue observations, not hardware underruns

limits: Short Class1 windows; no full-race/all-class/Mirror/30-minute acceptance
Live active-scene clock established in this build; original PS2 cadence and per-player lap timer still unconfirmed
No synchronized original/native visual parity claim
Callbacks are not scanout; queue-zero samples are not hardware underruns
Synthetic comparisons and intrusive sampling are not whole-game FPS
Host-load variation limits attribution; all adverse FPS/p95/stutter and synthetic results retained
No clean-PC or development-fallback-free packaging acceptance
Exact cause of the earlier v11/v12 Fuji regression is not isolated by the layout change; no hardware cache-coherence counters collected.
Three short repetitions and concurrent host activity limit attribution; preserve all v11/v12 data.
Observed candidate regressions not explained; no claim that external host activity caused them.
No temporary-DISC replacement, dummy media, downloaded game data or fabricated validation used.
Historical v13 images/matrix/queue checks are not new v14 validation.
